saveFilter.wav.description: File type name in the save dialog for a WAV export.

presetFile.saveTitle.description: Title of the dialog that saves presets to a file.

presetFile.openTitle.description: Title of the dialog that opens a preset file.

confirm.cancel.description: Cancel button of a confirmation in a translated UI.

updates.disabled.description: Settings › About › Updates: this build of Flown does not update itself (a build made without the update feed).

updates.never.description: Settings › About › Updates: no check has run since Flown was installed.

updates.upToDate.description: Settings › About › Updates: the last check found nothing newer.

updates.checking.description: Settings › About › Updates: a check is running.

updates.checkFailed.description: Settings › About › Updates: the check failed.

updates.downloadFailed.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download failed and automatic updates will try again. Main sets it; the page tells it apart from the manual form below by its text, so both come from this catalogue.

updates.downloadFailedManual.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download failed and automatic updates are off.

updates.notReady.description: Restart now was asked for, but no update is downloaded.

updates.available.description: Settings › About › Updates: a newer version exists; {version} is its number ("0.7.2").

updates.downloadingPercent.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download’s progress in percent.

updates.ready.description: Settings › About › Updates and Home’s title bar: an update is downloaded.

updates.downloading.description: Settings › About › Updates: what screen readers hear while the update downloads (without the percent); also the progress bar’s name.

busy.recording.description: Why Flown cannot restart now (to install an update or change language): a recording is running.

busy.processing.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a finished recording is still being saved or processed.

busy.export.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: an export is running.

busy.captions.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: captions are being made.

busy.analysis.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: the sound is being analysed.

busy.import.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a video is being imported.

busy.voice.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: Clean voice is working. "Clean voice" is the feature’s name.

busy.copy.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a project is being copied.

busy.share.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a video is being shared.

brandKit.fontTitle.description: Settings › Brand kit: the title of the file dialog that adds a font.

export.thumbnailTitle.description: The title of the save dialog for a thumbnail image.

export.saveTitle.description: The title of the save dialog for an export.

guide.pdfTitle.description: The title of the save dialog for a step-by-step guide as PDF.

guide.demoTitle.description: The title of the save dialog for a click-through demo.

guide.htmlTitle.description: The title of the save dialog for a guide as a web page.

jobs.exporting.description: Windows taskbar: what a running export is doing.

jobs.makingCaptions.description: Windows taskbar: what a running captions job is doing.

jobs.reading.description: Windows taskbar: what a running sound or screen analysis is doing.

jobs.writingAi.description: Windows taskbar: what a long request to AI on this PC is doing.

jobs.exportFailed.description: Windows notification title when an export fails; the body says why.

jobs.captionsFailed.description: Windows notification title when making captions fails.

jobs.somethingWrong.description: Windows notification body when a job failed without a reason.

jobs.captionsReady.description: Windows notification title when captions are made.

jobs.captionsBody.description: Windows notification body when captions are made and the recording has no name.

jobs.exportFinished.description: Windows notification title when one file was exported.

jobs.fileBody.description: Windows notification body: the exported file name and its size (e.g. "Demo.mp4 · 2.8 MB").

jobs.filesExported.description: Windows notification title when a batch exported several files.

import.title.description: Title of the Windows open dialog for importing a video file.

import.videos.description: File type filter in the Windows open dialog: video files.

import.allFiles.description: File type filter in the Windows open dialog: any file.

projectsIpc.images.description: File type filter in the Windows open dialog for a background image.

projectsIpc.cursorImages.description: File type filter in the Windows open dialog for a cursor image.

asset.title.watermark.description: Title of the Windows open dialog: picking a watermark or logo image.

asset.title.overlay.description: Title of the Windows open dialog: adding an image overlay.

asset.title.font.description: Title of the Windows open dialog: adding a font file.

asset.title.music.description: Title of the Windows open dialog: picking a background music file.

asset.title.lut.description: Title of the Windows open dialog: importing a .cube colour LUT.

asset.filter.images.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: image files.

asset.filter.fonts.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: font files.

asset.filter.audio.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: audio files.

asset.filter.luts.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: .cube LUT files.

captions.filter.srt.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: SRT subtitle files.

captions.filter.vtt.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: WebVTT subtitle files.

captions.filter.txt.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: plain text files.

saveFilter.mp4.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: MP4 video files.

saveFilter.webm.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: WebM video files.

saveFilter.mov.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: QuickTime .mov files.

saveFilter.m4a.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: M4A audio files.

saveFilter.png.description: File type filter in a Windows open or save dialog: PNG image files (a thumbnail).

aiCheck.works.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check of a service added by address: the first line when it answers in JSON with a schema.

aiCheck.worksChecked.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check of a service added by address: the first line when it answers only in plain JSON or text.

aiCheck.schema.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the second line, how the service answers.

aiCheck.plainJson.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the second line, how the service answers.

aiCheck.plainText.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the second line, how the service answers.

aiCheck.keyWorks.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the OpenAI key was accepted.

aiCheck.keyWorksModel.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the Gemini key was accepted and {model} (the model name typed or chosen) can be used.

aiCheck.keyWorksClaude.description: Settings › AI providers, Save and check: the Anthropic key was accepted and {model} (the model name) can be used.

jobs.open.description: Button of the "Export finished" notification that opens the exported file (the verb).

localAi.stopped.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): the run was stopped (by Stop, or because the tool closed).

localAi.waiting.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): progress while another tool uses it.

localAi.lowMemory.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): shown after the progress, after " · ", while free memory is low (no full stop).

localAi.written.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): under text the model wrote.

localAi.pcLine.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): this PC's line in Settings; {gb} is whole gigabytes of memory.

localAi.lessThanAMinute.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): time left while it writes, after "On this PC: writing…" (lower case, no full stop).

localAi.minutesLeft.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): time left while it writes, after "On this PC: writing…" (lower case, no full stop).

localAi.loading.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): progress beside a busy button.

localAi.reading.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): progress beside a busy button; {percent} is 0 to 100.

localAi.writing.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): progress beside a busy button; {left} is the time left ("about 2 minutes left").

localAi.speed.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): the measured speed in Settings; {read} and {write} are words a second.

localAi.model.recommended.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): the larger model's title in the model list.

localAi.model.recommendedHint.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): what the Recommended model is for.

localAi.model.small.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): the smaller model's title in the model list.

localAi.model.smallHint.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): what the Small model is for.

localAi.model.smallTitleNote.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): a note under a title tool when the Small model writes ("Small" is the model).

localAi.model.smallSummaryNote.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): a note under a summary tool when the Small model writes ("Small" is the model).

speech.tier.fast.description: Captions on this PC: a speech model's tier, as the Captions tab's quality chips and Settings name it. The quickest model.

speech.tier.standard.description: Captions on this PC: a speech model's tier, as the Captions tab's quality chips and Settings name it. The recommended model.

speech.tier.accurate.description: Captions on this PC: a speech model's tier, as the Captions tab's quality chips and Settings name it. A slower, more accurate model.

speech.tier.best.description: Captions on this PC: a speech model's tier, as the Captions tab's quality chips and Settings name it. The slowest, most accurate model.

speech.tier.bangla.description: Captions on this PC: a speech model's tier, as the Captions tab's quality chips and Settings name it. The model made for Bangla speech.

speech.duration.underMinute.description: Captions on this PC: how long making captions will take, under a minute (lower case: it follows other words, as in "about 3 min for this recording").

speech.duration.minutes.description: Captions on this PC: how long making captions will take; {minutes} is a number of minutes, possibly with ½ ("1½").

speech.duration.hoursMinutes.description: Captions on this PC: how long making captions will take, in hours and minutes.

speech.duration.hours.description: Captions on this PC: how long making captions will take, in whole hours.

notes.hiddenScreen.description: Speaker notes: the warning when a screen or area recording starts on a Windows version that cannot keep the notes out of the video. "Windows 10 version 2004" is a product version, kept as is.

notes.hiddenWindow.description: Speaker notes: the warning when a window recording starts on a Windows version that cannot keep the notes out of the video.

notes.hotkeyUsedElsewhere.description: Speaker notes: a notes hotkey another app holds. {key} is the key combination as keycaps (never translated); {action} is the hotkey's name ("Notes: back").

notes.hotkeyInvalid.description: Speaker notes: a notes hotkey Windows refused. {key} is the key combination as keycaps (never translated); {action} is the hotkey's name. "Speaker notes" is the dialog where hotkeys are chosen.

notes.windowTitle.description: Speaker notes: the title of the notes window (the taskbar and window lists never show it, but screen readers read it).

shareIpc.testPosted.description: Settings › Share: said after Test posted a message to a chat. {label} is the chat's name as the user gave it.

share.postedTo.description: Share: a finished post in the "Shared" notification. {label} is the chat's name.

share.savedTo.description: Share: a finished copy in the "Shared" notification. {place} is the folder, "OneDrive › Flown".

share.failedTitle.description: Share: the title of the notification when a share failed.

share.copyTo.description: Share: a button on the export's notification that copies the video into a cloud folder. {place} is the folder's name, shortened.

share.postTo.description: Share: a button on the export's notification that posts the video's title to a chat. {place} is the chat's name, shortened.

share.alreadyIn.description: Share: a copy step that found the same video already in the folder. {place} is the folder, "OneDrive › Flown".

share.sharedTitle.description: Share: the title of the notification when every step of a share finished.

share.folder.oneDriveWork.description: Settings › Share: the name of a OneDrive folder found on this PC for a work or school account whose organisation has no name. "OneDrive" is Microsoft's product name.

share.folder.dropboxWork.description: Settings › Share: the name of the Dropbox folder found on this PC for a work (business) account. "Dropbox" is the service's name.

jobs.more.failed.description: Added after a batch export notification body when some files failed (starts with the " · " separator). English shows it in pieces as before (a merge group, output-and-languages §9.3); other languages show only the group’s .whole message.

jobs.more.stopped.description: Added after a batch export notification body when the batch was stopped (starts with the " · " separator). English shows it in pieces as before (a merge group, output-and-languages §9.3); other languages show only the group’s .whole message.

localSpeech.testName.description: What the key check of AI providers answers for captions made on this PC (no key to check).

jobs.more.whole.description: The notification after a batch export, its body whole: {lead} is the file and its size, or the folder; failed yes adds how many files failed ({n}); stopped yes says the batch stopped early. Used only when the UI language is not English (merge group, output-and-languages §9.3): English builds the same sentence from its pieces.
